title: 80 Persons arrested under Local and Special Laws During 1973, 26,87,183 persons were arrested under Local and Special Laws in 24,80,918 cases. The highest percentage of persons arrested was noticed under the Motor Vehicles Act (21·27 percent) followed by Gambling Act (12·62 percent). The pattern of arrests under different heads was more or less the same as during 1972. The relevant statistics at All India level are presented in Table 23 while similar statistics in different States, UTs and Cities are presented in Table 24.
